blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Four times thirty-seven times twenty-five.
Four and twenty-five make one hundred, but they're far apart. Swap the thirty-seven and the twenty-five.
Now group the four with the twenty-five.
Four times twenty-five is one hundred.
One hundred times thirty-seven is three thousand seven hundred.
So the answer is three thousand seven hundred.
Watch out for these traps. If you add four and twenty-five, you get one thousand seventy-three. If you add the thirty-seven, you get one hundred thirty-seven.
